robots.name: 胶囊 · 只减速 · 进镜→退镜

config.normal_load_model: N_eff = M * norm(g), not solved contact load
config.gravity_frame_assumption: Assumed supine anatomy; gravity fixed in world -Z; source anatomical axes unverified
config.field_model: Eight point-dipole coils with bounded currents
config.reference_model: clamped position CubicSpline + RotationSpline; derivatives rebuilt
config.friction_model: smooth equivalent sliding drag, no static friction or contact

registry.field_scope_model_notice: Widened scopes extrapolate the existing instantaneous local affine field; not a solved actuator field.

geometry.surface_notice: Colon001 inner-wall mesh, decimated shared evaluation surface; no clinical texture

coordinate_transform.original: none; raw STL agrees with source trajectory coordinate bounds

patient_posture.label: 仰卧姿态假设
patient_posture.mapping: original X -> world X; original Z -> world -Y; original Y -> world Z
patient_posture.gravity_frame: fixed world -Z, not rotated with anatomy
patient_posture.array_frame: fixed world +Z side; currents and motion recomputed
patient_posture.assumption: Raw mesh has no verified anatomical orientation; assumed supine placement, not patient registration

evaluation.notice: Shared decimated entire lumen surface; raster cell visibility; centroid distance/incidence approximation; simulated geometry quality only; no clinical texture validation

coordinationSummary.scope: Insertion coordination only; no withdrawal or observation dwell planning.
coordinationSummary.notice: Offline replay-verified scheduling, not online gimbal release. Failed or unnecessary predicted waits are removed and robot-camera dynamics recomputed until all retained waits pass exact-boundary state checks. P95 uses nearly uniform replay samples plus exact hold boundaries.

summary.method_notice: Eight-coil dynamics coupled with original dense window search + 1.2 s prediction + 0.01 s PD; actual wall coverage recomputed. Not measured or clinical coverage.

roundTrip.note: Continuous magnetic dynamics; capsule, gimbal and array anchor carried across reversal. No pose reset.

magneticSimulation.field_model: Point-dipole sources, not FEM or measured hardware
